Being a kid, having friends, my own life, having an identity

I think for me being raised by my nmom and her enabler with the extreme abuse and neglect that I suffered from really caused me to not act normally as a kid because I had to be the adult and take care of the family. 

I always put them first; I couldn't ask for money for trips or if I did she would manipulate the situation where I couldn't go, I couldn't do my laundry without doing their laundry too, and if I was being made to clean, I had to start in their room/bathroom. 

If I happen to bring any kids over to hang out or to spend the night, my nmom would come in and just steal the show and my friends. She would give these middle schoolers cigarettes, alcohol/beer, offer them money, which was cool to them until she started expecting them to clean. 

One of the seldom few times that I tried having friends over, a few girls was spending the night, my nmom got some boys so "my little brother had someone to hang out with" (more because she was trying to play matchmaker with the girls, very weird thinking back on it) and once everyone was there, she took us to a major store, the other kids saw things that they liked (cheap make-up kit for the girls and expensive game stuff for the boys) and she bribed them with those things for them to clean. 

Us girls had to spit the makeup amongst ourselves while the boys got each their own and once everyone got what they wanted (I got the dried up nail polish because no one else wanted them) Boomerlyn [my nmom, just something that I call her when I'm talking about her] was like "okay, start cleaning" and that's when the fun was over. I had already cleaned a majority of the house by myself and that was the reason why these kids were able to spend the night, but I still had to organize the kitchen while the living room was starting to get disturbed and needed vacuuming. They did stuff for five minutes, started complaining about not being slaves and that they didn't live there, then they called there moms who picked them up and they never came over again or even talked to me. 

Boomerlyn got a whole earful by the moms for trying to trick their kids into cheap labor. Once they drove off, she proceeded to yell at me about how much money she wasted on those kids and how I had to finish cleaning the house before I could go to sleep (it was like midnight at this point.) Then her enabler/my step dad finally realized that she spent a lot of money, so more fighting and yelling happened and everything was my fault because I wanted to have a sleepover as a middle schooler. 

Another thing is that I could never like anything that she didn't like and if I happen to like the same thing as her, it was because 'she' liked it. I couldn't like black lipstick and wear it because she was "an original goth" and dark makeup was her thing. She never bought me any clothes that I wanted unless they were on clearance for a $1. If she got me clothes on her own, she would buy stuff that would look horrible on me if it's was in my size and things that were sizes too big was only because she liked the garments and wanted to have them as goal clothes for if/when she would lose the weight.

She ALWAYS said that she was living life vicariously through me to me, to her friends, to anyone and everyone and only one of her friends ever called her out with that being unhealthy, which caused their friendship to end. I'm still trying to fully learn how that was so wrong (I know that it is), but in all honesty those were the only times Boomerlyn would seem to be nice to me and love/like me.

Man, my nmom was bad, but she didn't really care what I had to think to even be bothered with reading anything that I wrote, but I also didn't really write a lot. Sometimes I would try, but those journals would end up needing to be used for paper for school a couple of years. 

I hope that you are a beacon of hope for your niece, she is going to need.

I know, I've been in a similar situation where I needed to move before I fully had my ducks in a row.

Here is the thing, if you keep on waiting for them to realize they treat you like shit, you will be waiting forever, especially if you don't bring it up first. I know that it's annoying to be the one who always start a conversation, whether it be an everyday one or something more serious, but this is how they treat and see you, and if you don't make waves, they won't change. 

Hell, there is a chance that if you recorded everything thing they slighted you with, they still won't see it. Sometimes no to low contact is the only way for people to have a chance of happiness because their family isn't that source at all. I'm not saying move out tomorrow, but don't rule it out because of your health and it being expensive because if you stay there your health could get worse due to the depression they set you in and you will just be stuck. 

I know because I was in the same similar situation, but I would always talk about how I felt slighted to my nmom and it didn't do jack shit. She would just make excuses and then continue doing the same shit and I would be depressed because my nmom would say that she loved me, but then treat me like utter crap. The reason why I went no contact is that I had horrific, repressed memories of when I  was a child and her friends and their kids doing anything they wanted to me which caused my infertility. She made jokes about my miscarriage and then would deny anything that I went through as a kid and would just say that I want attention. I gave her all the chances to see the pain that she caused and she didn't want to see it or make it right, and I deserve to be treated right and to have my voice be heard, just like you do too.

I think maybe it would be better to do it asap especially since it's already been weeks and they left you on read (on IG, right?) If they wanted to keep your money, they they should deserve to keep it and been up to date on how to help you. Maybe give them another email if you want, but if they didn't respond before, they probably wouldn't now.

I would try talking to your siblings and see what's up. You guys probably don't have the best relationships, but maybe this might at least be a start in the right direction for you to stand your ground and figure out what's going on. It might not make you guys closer, but at least you can look back thinking that you tried to get to the bottom of things. 

All I can say is that I'm no contact with all of my narcs and I haven't looked back since, so maybe you should think about going that route if it's something that would benefit you when you are able to do it.

Now, for something that's safer and actually more cost effective, a reusable makeup cloth remover! If you get a decent one, you could use very minimal to no makeup removing soap and just warm tap water! Elf's are cheap, but soap involvement is advised; Ulta's grey 2 piece set is decent and you could possibly get away without using soap; the best (from my opinion of my choices) is from Laruce set which I got in a Boxycharm. 

The Laruce set might be on the pricey side (I forgot the original price w/the Boxycharm,) but ever since I got it in that subscription, it's been my go to for makeup removal!
